titles.romaji: Kero Kero Keroppi no Tomodachi wa Mahou Tsukai
titles.native: けろけろけろっぴの友だちは魔法使い

description: The story begins when Arcana, who is practicing magic, visits Keroppi. Keroppi's friends are surprised by the magic of Arcana, but that night the birthday present for Kerorinu disappears. Who stole the present?
